voices.name: Người dẫn truyện
voices.base_style: the storyteller of this film, a warm Vietnamese man around forty; calm, unhurried, intimate, never theatrical.
voices.design_prompt: A Vietnamese man in his early forties, native speaker with a standard Northern Vietnamese (Hà Nội) accent. A warm, deep baritone with a soft, slightly breathy texture, like the narrator of a gentle documentary or a family film. He speaks unhurriedly and clearly, with natural pauses between phrases, and a faint smile in his voice. Calm, trustworthy, a little nostalgic, never theatrical or announcer-like. Close, intimate microphone, quiet room, no music, no reverb.
voices.test_line: Chiều hôm đó, Tí và Tèo quay lại căn nhà cũ của bà. Mọi thứ dường như vẫn còn ở nguyên vị trí.

voices.name: Cô giáo
voices.base_style: a friendly Vietnamese secondary-school teacher around twenty-eight, speaking to her whole class; bright, clear, encouraging.
voices.design_prompt: A Vietnamese woman about 28 years old, a friendly secondary-school teacher, native speaker with a standard Northern Vietnamese (Hà Nội) accent. Bright, clear and lively mid-range voice, speaking to a whole class with gentle enthusiasm, as if announcing an exciting school project. Well-articulated, energetic but kind, smiling. Recorded as if in a quiet classroom, no echo, no background noise.
voices.test_line: Năm nay, mỗi đội sẽ lựa chọn một vùng văn hóa Việt Nam, tìm hiểu một loại trang phục truyền thống.

voices.name: Tí
voices.base_style: Tí, a lively 13-year-old Vietnamese boy; quick and playful, a little cocky; when unsure he slows down and hesitates but stays clearly audible.
voices.design_prompt: A light, bright, youthful male voice with a slightly high pitch, native Vietnamese speaker with a Northern (Hà Nội) accent. Quick, playful, energetic and a little cheeky; when unsure he slows down and hesitates but stays clearly audible. Natural everyday speech, not a cartoon voice. Clean recording, no background noise.
voices.test_line: Áo dài thôi. Quá dễ! … Ơ, nhưng mà… bộ này của vùng nào nhỉ?

voices.name: Tèo
voices.base_style: Tèo, Tí's thoughtful 13-year-old best friend with glasses; calm, curious, speaks a little slower, gently amused.
voices.design_prompt: A soft, youthful male voice, slightly lower and calmer than an excited talker, native Vietnamese speaker with a Northern (Hà Nội) accent. Thoughtful and curious, speaks a little slowly, polite, gently amused. Natural everyday speech, not a cartoon voice. Clean recording, no background noise.
voices.test_line: Tại sao lại là áo dài? Còn gì nữa không?

voices.name: Tí lúc bé
voices.base_style: Tí as a small child in a warm memory: the same voice as Tí but lighter, softer, higher and slower, innocent and curious, clearly audible.
voices.design_prompt: A very light, small, high and soft male voice, native Vietnamese speaker with a Northern (Hà Nội) accent. Innocent-sounding, gentle and curious, speaks slowly and a little shyly; warm and natural, not a cartoon voice. Soft, warm recording, no background noise.
voices.test_line: Bà ơi… Cái này có phải áo dài không?

voices.name: Bà
voices.base_style: Bà, Tí's 75-year-old grandmother from Kinh Bắc, a retired seamstress; warm, slow, tender, wise, a quiet smile in her voice.
voices.design_prompt: An elderly Vietnamese woman about 75 years old, a grandmother and retired seamstress from the Kinh Bắc region, native speaker with a soft Northern Vietnamese (Hà Nội / Bắc Ninh) accent. Warm, gentle and loving, with a slightly husky, aged texture but still clear. She speaks slowly and tenderly, as if talking to her grandchild beside her, with a quiet smile and a touch of nostalgia; wise, never preachy. Intimate close microphone, quiet room, no music, no reverb.
voices.test_line: Không phải cái gì dài dài cũng là áo dài đâu con. Hành trình của con bắt đầu từ đây.
